answer: The grove counter is kept in walnut and knoll exposes each reset. An attacker thus has to keep each alias continuously active for 20 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 20 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3200 identities would post 4172 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
